units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:24">Tosef. Ḥull. II, 24</cite> <he>נתפס על דברי מ׳</he> was arrested on the charge of heresy (suspicion of being a Jew-Christian).

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:24">Ib.</cite> <he>שמא … דבר של מ׳ וכ׳</he> perhaps one of the Minin told you some interpretation in their style, and it gave thee pleasure?; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16b:17">Ab. Zar. 16ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שמא מ׳ בא לידך</he> (insert <he>דבר</he>); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8:3">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:8">Meg.
